5
Nwoma no ne Adwammaa no
1 # Adi 4.2; Hes 2.9-10 Na mehunuu nwoma bi wɔ deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no nifa mu a wɔatwerɛ emu ne akyire, na wɔde nsɔano nson asosɔ ano. 2Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi a ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Hwan na ɔfata sɛ ɔbue nwoma no mu na ɔte ne nsɔano no? 3Na obiara nni soro anaa asase so anaa asase ase a ɔbɛtumi abue nwoma no mu anaasɛ ɔbɛhwɛ mu. 4Na mesuu pii, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnhunu obi a ɔfata sɛ ɔbɛbue nwoma no mu anaasɛ ɔbɛhwɛ mu. 5#Gye 49.9-10; Yes 11.1; 11.10; Adi 22.16 Na mpanimfoɔ no mu baako ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsu, hwɛ, Yuda abusuakuo mu Gyata no, Dawid nhini no adi nkonim sɛ ɔbɛbue nwoma no mu na watete ne nsɔano nson no.
6 # Yes 53.7; Yoh 1.29; 1.36; Sak 4.10; Adi 4.5 Na mehwɛe, na ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ntam ne mpanimfoɔ no ntam no, adwammaa bi gyina hɔ a ɔte sɛdeɛ wɔaku no. Ɔwɔ mmɛn nson ne ani nson a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ahonhom nson a wɔasoma wɔn kɔ asase nyinaa soɔ no. 7Na ɔba bɛgyee nwoma no firii deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no nifa mu.
8 # Adi 14.2; 15.2; 8.3-4 Na ɔgyee nwoma no no, ateasefoɔ baanan no ne mpanimfoɔ aduonu nan no hwehwee ase adwammaa no anim, wɔn nyinaa kurakura nsankuo ne sika mfamfa a ohwam a ɛyɛ ahotefoɔ mpaebɔ no ayɛ no mama. 9#Dwom 33.3 Na wɔtoo dwom foforɔ sɛ:
Wofata sɛ wogye nwoma no
na wobue ne nsɔano no,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔaku wo, na wode wo mogya atɔ yɛn ama Onyankopɔn,
afiri mmusua ne ɔkasa ne nkurɔfoɔ ne aman nyinaa mu,
10 # Adi 1.6; 20.6; 22.5 na woayɛ wɔn ahemman ne asɔfoɔ ama yɛn Nyankopɔn,
na wɔbɛdi asase so ahene.
11 # Dan 7.10 Na mehwɛe, na metee abɔfoɔ bebree a wɔatwa ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ no ne mpanimfoɔ no ho kɔntɔnkrɔn nne, wɔn ano si mpempem ne mpem ahodoɔ mpem, 12#1 Be 29.11; Flp 2.9-10 na wɔde nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ:
Adwammaa a wɔkumm no no fata sɛ
ɔgye tumi, ne ahonya, ne nyansa, ne ahoɔden, ne anidie,
ne animuonyam ne nhyira.
13Na abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ soro ne asase soɔ ne asase ase ne ɛpo so ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, metee sɛ wɔse:
Nhyira ne anidie ne animuonyam
ne tumi nka deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ, ne adwammaa no
daa daa!
14 # Adi 4.10; 19.4 Na ateasefoɔ baanan no kaa sɛ: Amen. Na mpanimfoɔ no hwehwee ase, na wɔkoto sɔree.

Na mehunuu nwoma bi wɔ deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no nifa mu a wɔatwerɛ emu ne akyire, na wɔde nsɔano nson asosɔ ano. Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi a ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Hwan na ɔfata sɛ ɔbue nwoma no mu na ɔte ne nsɔano no? Na obiara nni soro anaa asase so anaa asase ase a ɔbɛtumi abue nwoma no mu anaasɛ ɔbɛhwɛ mu. Na mesuu pii, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnhunu obi a ɔfata sɛ ɔbɛbue nwoma no mu anaasɛ ɔbɛhwɛ mu. Na mpanimfoɔ no mu baako ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsu, hwɛ, Yuda abusuakuo mu Gyata no, Dawid nhini no adi nkonim sɛ ɔbɛbue nwoma no mu na watete ne nsɔano nson no.
Na mehwɛe, na ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ntam ne mpanimfoɔ no ntam no, adwammaa bi gyina hɔ a ɔte sɛdeɛ wɔaku no. Ɔwɔ mmɛn nson ne ani nson a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ahonhom nson a wɔasoma wɔn kɔ asase nyinaa soɔ no. Na ɔba bɛgyee nwoma no firii deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no nifa mu.
Na ɔgyee nwoma no no, ateasefoɔ baanan no ne mpanimfoɔ aduonu nan no hwehwee ase adwammaa no anim, wɔn nyinaa kurakura nsankuo ne sika mfamfa a ohwam a ɛyɛ ahotefoɔ mpaebɔ no ayɛ no mama. Na wɔtoo dwom foforɔ sɛ:
Wofata sɛ wogye nwoma no
na wobue ne nsɔano no,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔaku wo, na wode wo mogya atɔ yɛn ama Onyankopɔn,
afiri mmusua ne ɔkasa ne nkurɔfoɔ ne aman nyinaa mu,
na woayɛ wɔn ahemman ne asɔfoɔ ama yɛn Nyankopɔn,
na wɔbɛdi asase so ahene.
Na mehwɛe, na metee abɔfoɔ bebree a wɔatwa ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ no ne mpanimfoɔ no ho kɔntɔnkrɔn nne, wɔn ano si mpempem ne mpem ahodoɔ mpem, na wɔde nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ:
Adwammaa a wɔkumm no no fata sɛ
ɔgye tumi, ne ahonya, ne nyansa, ne ahoɔden, ne anidie,
ne animuonyam ne nhyira.
Na abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ soro ne asase soɔ ne asase ase ne ɛpo so ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, metee sɛ wɔse:
Nhyira ne anidie ne animuonyam
ne tumi nka deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ, ne adwammaa no
daa daa!
Na ateasefoɔ baanan no kaa sɛ: Amen. Na mpanimfoɔ no hwehwee ase, na wɔkoto sɔree.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
